panel.csv.description: Raw tidy-long panel exactly as extracted from the live DoFE wide tables and report annex tables.

columns.doc_id: Source document id (DoFE content id, or report2020_annex_*, preapproval_0NN).
columns.period_bs: Printed BS period as printed (year, or 'year month' for monthly reports).
columns.period_ad_start: AD start date of the reporting window (ISO), when printed.
columns.period_ad_end: AD end date of the reporting window (ISO), when printed.
columns.doc_type: Classified document type (annual | single_month | progress | annex | ...).
columns.row_type: detail (an entity) | total (printed Total row) | grand_total.
columns.name: Entity name exactly as printed (raw, unresolved).
columns.sn: Source serial number / row order within the document.
columns.count: Approved labour permits in this cell.
columns.source_page: Page of the source PDF the row came from.
columns.verified: True when the source document's extraction passed its math audit.

panel_canonical.csv.gz.description: Primary analysis dataset: panel.csv with canonical entities/channels/fiscal years and within-document typo-row merges applied. Gzipped CSV.

columns.period_ad_start: AD start date of the reporting window (ISO).
columns.period_ad_end: AD end date of the reporting window (ISO).
columns.name: Entity name exactly as printed (raw).
columns.count: Approved labour permits (summed across merged typo-rows).
columns.verified: Source document passed its extraction math audit.
columns.source_url: URL of the source PDF (first contributing document).
columns.entity_type: country | district (empty on printed total rows).
columns.iso3: ISO-3166 alpha-3 country code (empty for districts/totals).
columns.entity_note: Provenance note for the canonical entity (e.g. a pre-2018 unified district assigned to its HQ province); empty when none.
columns.entity_resolved: true when the raw name matched a canonical entity.
columns.fiscal_year: Canonical BS fiscal year label, e.g. '2079/80'.
columns.granularity: month | year | measure (aggregation level of the document).
columns.reconciled_fiscal_year: Fiscal year after documented period overrides.
columns.period_override: true when reconciled_fiscal_year differs from fiscal_year.
columns.merged_rows: Number of raw rows collapsed into this canonical key.
columns.raw_names: Semicolon-joined distinct printed names merged into this row.

agencies.csv.description: Recruiting-agency-level pre-approval and institutional permit detail.

columns.period_ad_start: AD start date of the reporting window (ISO).
columns.period_ad_end: AD end date of the reporting window (ISO).
columns.lot_no: Recruiting-agency licence / lot number, when printed.
columns.verified: Source document passed its extraction math audit.

series.csv.description: Historical known-series matrices (approvals, deaths, complaints, ...) from narrative reports.

columns.caption: Table caption as printed.
columns.dimension: Dimension the series is broken down by (country, cause, ...).
columns.name: Entity / category name (raw).
columns.gender: male | female | total | (blank for matrix rows).
